name: Shiera
source:
Works part-time at an Anna Miller's-style cafe while searching for the Moon Drop. Lives alone.

She's restless and a bit crude, but livelier than anyone else to the point of being dazzling.

Dreams of becoming the best witch in the world.

[Based off description from the [url=http://www.sp-janis.com/janis/magicalpalette/]Janis official website[/url]]
